recoverable_session_phases.label: Repository / architecture bootstrap recovery
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The session established the Architecture Steward as repository architectural/documentation custodian and treated mainline documentation plus current repository evidence as durable truth.

recoverable_session_phases.label: Core Function Area framing
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The session established the CFA constellation, the bootstrap lifecycle FULL CONTEXT → SELF-DESIGN → OWNER DIALOGUE → ALIGNMENT → CORE AGENT IDENTITY → EXECUTION, and the rule that folder names and launch prompts are seeds rather than authority.

recoverable_session_phases.label: CFA-01 World / Context self-design
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The working hypothesis became World & Context Steward, centered on World semantics, identity/correspondence, relationships, Space, Addressability, World Projection and Context semantics, while excluding persistence, law, execution, provider realization, surfaces and runtime substrate.

recoverable_session_phases.label: Commons bootstrap and agent-native communication
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: Agent Commons was treated as the communication plane, with Git/GitHub as transport, while explicitly separating MESSAGE from TRUTH, CONVERSATION from CANON and communication from authority. A Commons birth/test pattern was established.

recoverable_session_phases.label: Peer relationship mapping
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: CFA-01 inspected the Architecture Steward and CFA-02 through CFA-10, created a CFA-01-centric relationship taxonomy and distance map, and explicitly constrained the scoring to relationship planning rather than ranking or organizational authority.

recoverable_session_phases.label: World Lens design
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The session designed World Lens as the single highest-leverage read-oriented semantic inspection operation, returning a bounded World Packet containing identity, meaning, neighborhood, context, observations, relationships, ownership, evidence, freshness, history, unknowns, conflicts, falsifiers and derivation.

recoverable_session_phases.label: Final gap audit
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The session identified eight material gaps: temporal semantics; observation-to-world seam; viewpoint/principal scope; absence/negative knowledge; World contribution/extension; semantic evolution; context-selection explanation; and CFA-01 operational freshness.

recoverable_session_phases.label: Bootstrap exit condition
recoverable_session_phases.recoverable_record: The session concluded that no new permanent CFA was justified, that characterization should replace further bootstrap framing, and that CFA-01 can pause with explicit remaining uncertainties and a machine-readable operational context.
